facts.subject: Water safety campaign
facts.statement: The health ministry has launched a campaign reminding residents to drink water regularly during the current heatwave.

source_ref.text_snippet: The health ministry has launched a campaign reminding residents to drink water regularly during the current heatwave.

facts.subject: Swimming safety
facts.statement: Swimming in rivers and lakes is discouraged where there is no lifeguard, and several sites have been marked with warning signs.

source_ref.text_snippet: Swimming in rivers and lakes is discouraged where there is no lifeguard, and several sites have been marked with warning signs.

facts.subject: Heat exhaustion cases
facts.statement: The ministry said hospitals have seen an increase in cases of heat exhaustion but that services remain open.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry said hospitals have seen an increase in cases of heat exhaustion but that services remain open.

flagged_facts.subject: Free advice line
flagged_facts.statement: A free advice line will operate during daylight hours for the rest of the week.

source_ref.text_snippet: A free advice line will operate during daylight hours for the rest of the week.
